description:
A moderate hiking trail, great for a quick side trip while in Quesnel. Trail follows Narcosli Creek then turns up Deserter Creek to the impressive waterfalls on Deserter Creek.

*** Caution, recent slide activity has compromised the trail condition, use at your own risk*****
Trail is well maintained, but has a moderate rating and great for a day trip with the kids. If it is really hot, there is a great swimming hole by the parking area.
directions: From Quesnel head to the West side of town, follow the Westfraser Road approximately 20km to the Narcosli Creek Bridge. Parking is on the left and the traihead on the right.

stats.Closure: The recreation trail is closed due to flooding and safety concerns.

title: Deserters Creek Falls
